result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I would shortlist **Dropbox Sign, signNow, and PandaDoc**\. They offer a good balance of affordability, ease of use, and professional signing features without the complexity of enterprise software.

My recommendation depends on whether you primarily send contracts, manage client paperwork, or create sales proposals.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

- Easy to set up and use.
- Reusable templates and signature reminders.
- Good for client agreements, service contracts, and employee paperwork.
- Paid plans offer unlimited signature requests.

Reported starting price: approximately \$15 USD/month.

[Dropbox Sign website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![Best e-signature software | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wmbNwQd5sZcCQM_y8xDHl0CPe7pgdwCT-krxdtJ31tc_1PKqy7PiBHAl_-Gd913WdMSfKG4tvcbm87CrehlVzyh0S_XfsJoy8bGchL0mjaA3hnz0pBJgnLcUXZcQanS1poRpGWtqsda_EXu0W3Y1sz9Tm8p7il83hsR4mOfYqnnCRPXfp1UL4Ot3PT4uhG1W?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. signNow**

(Best budget option)

- Affordable for small businesses.
- Templates, reminders, and signing workflows.
- Useful for multiple employees sending agreements.
- Good core functionality without paying for a large document-management suite.

Reported starting price: approximately \$8 USD/month with annual billing.

[signNow website](https://www.signnow.com/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales and proposals)

- Create professional proposals and contracts.
- Add pricing tables and payment options.
- Track when customers open and sign documents.
- Connect with CRM systems.

Reported starting price: approximately \$19 USD/user/month annually.

[PandaDoc website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![DocuSign | Drupal.org](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/KnjjkNsArYHxJT9b-dVAObwNdV_Jl84SkMMGMmhEeD469fCZGZb6iXwe0wldx7tajElbFIO70Ips_EMyI94QPngbvbdLAMsyDyX6-ZQNRQ5-GnHlCmjsf5gHtUh497prF-y231caB57b34MMJ7-kkzWq_2oTRaZSMm4RhRowSRiJ7LopVUJDR5EPPajhmEJs?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. DocuSign**

- Widely recognized by customers and businesses.
- Extensive integrations.
- Strong document tracking and signing workflows.
- Good if you expect to grow or need more sophisticated processes.

Reported starting price: approximately \$10–\$15 USD/month for an individual plan.

[DocuSign website](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Logo Wordmark PNG Vector - BrandLogo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/95na-wLQUN9p7GmfVbVlsMH9WIm3-bHOmsuOzR4w7FH_LNHajHgaUKajbYSFfuQalq9gsQjPtmcFPYYjJQoXKBtI8uyMeQC8oBjmdwkaHvf0cQn2ZgYIR22CA9JGfELZMa-MGbcgzYfhWePcbsbIj2Mlr0RTRu05Ww7rIP3mtZmaOkamqppjBubOBDVYwJ7W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent for businesses working with PDFs.
- Combines PDF editing and electronic signatures.
- Useful for document-heavy administrative work.

Reported starting price: approximately \$16.99 USD/month.

[Adobe Acrobat Sign website](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-sign.html)

These are approximate published starting prices, not guaranteed Canadian checkout prices. Plan limits, annual commitments, and taxes can change the actual cost. [helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-esignature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.pandadoc.com](https://www.pandadoc.com/blog/best-electronic-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a small business\:

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Simple contracts and agreements | Dropbox Sign |
| Lowest cost | signNow |
| Sales proposals and quotes | PandaDoc |
| Widely recognized platform | DocuSign |
| PDF editing and signing | Adobe Acrobat Sign |


**One important consideration in Canada\:** Make sure the platform provides a downloadable signed document and a detailed audit trail showing signer identity, timestamps, and signing activity. Electronic signatures are generally recognized under Canadian law, but certain document types have special requirements.

search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
